## Execution Sequence (6 Phases)

### Phase 1: Baseline tests (A9)
New specs in D:/Aworker/crx/playwright/tests/:
- boxing-conn-dsu.spec.ts — DSU group formation/disband, star toggle on/off, cross-level connection
- boxing-star-toggle.spec.ts — star mark add/remove/persistence across reload
- boxing-conn-zoom-follow.spec.ts — line endpoint follows box during zoom/pan (already partially in connections.spec)
- boxing-conn-cross-tab.spec.ts — cross-tab connection state sync via storage.onChanged
- boxing-conn-orphan-prune.spec.ts — delete box prunes orphan connections
All must PASS before Phase 2 starts.

### Phase 2: DSU simplification (A5)
- Delete layout.groups array from layout schema
- Add box.isParent boolean to box objects (large + small)
- toggleStarMark: set box.isParent instead of layout.groups.push/filter
- dsuRebuildFromConnections: read box.isParent from layout.boxes instead of layout.groups
- Remove addMember function (DSU auto-unions on connection)
- mergeConcurrentLayout: remove groups union step (box mergeById already handles isParent)
- pruneConnArrays: remove layout.groups filter step
- Regression: Bug #3 (unstar tombstone) root cause eliminated — no more groups vs DSU split
- Run Phase 1 tests: must all PASS

### Phase 3: Storage migration (A6)
- L41: const layoutStorage = api.storage.sync -> api.storage.local
- loadLayout: sync legacy migration reads sync first, copies to local, marks migrated
- onChanged listener already checks expectedArea, auto-switches to local
- Need: add unlimitedStorage permission to manifest permissions array (Chrome 5MB->unlimited, Firefox too)
- background.js debug flag: keep on storage.sync (small data, cross-device useful)
- localStorage fallback (BX-AUD-04): keep as safety net, rarely triggered
- saveLayoutDebounced 120ms: keep (local writes are cheap)
- Run Phase 1 tests + full suite: must PASS

### Phase 4: Performance optimizations (A4)
#1 Viewport culling for connections:
  - In renderConnections and scheduleConnRefresh, check if both endpoint boxes are within viewport bounds
  交界 (world coordinates vs canvasPanX/Y + canvasContainer size / zoom)
  - Offscreen connections: line.style.display = none (do not remove from DOM, just hide)
  - Panning: lazy show on rAF after pan ends
  - Pattern from: Cytoscape hideEdgesOnViewport, ReactFlow implicit windowing

#2 SVG path pooling:
  - Maintain a pool of disconnected SVG <line> elements
  - On connection removal: return line to pool instead of remove()
  - On connection add: take from pool instead of createElement
  - Prevents GC churn on frequent connect/disconnect

#3 LOD (level of detail):
  - zoom < 0.5: increase stroke-width to 2px, hide provisional line drag
  - zoom < 0.3: hide connection lines entirely (show only on hover/selection)
  - zoom >= 0.5: normal 1.5px stroke (current)

#4 ResizeObserver-driven conn refresh:
  - Box ResizeObserver (already exists at L478 for size observer) should also trigger refreshConnsForBox
  - Ensures connection endpoints update when box size changes (auto-expand toggle, manual resize)
  - Run Phase 1 tests: must PASS

### Phase 5: Build-time validation scripts (A7 + A8)

#7 i18n key consistency check (in build.mjs):
  - Parse all _locales/*/messages.json keys into sets
  - Parse I18N_FALLBACK keys in ntp.js
  - Parse data-i18n/data-i18n-title/data-i18n-placeholder attributes in index.html
  - Assert: all 15 locale key sets are identical
  - Assert: I18N_FALLBACK superset of en locale keys
  - Assert: every data-i18n attribute maps to a real key
  - Fail build on mismatch

#8 CSS dual-write marker check (in build.mjs):
  - Parse ntp.css for all rules containing .large-box
  - For each, check .small-box counterpart exists in same scope
  - Check BX-DUAL-WRITE / BX-DUAL-WRITE-SHARED / LARGE-ONLY / SMALL-ONLY marker present
  - Fail build if .large-box rule lacks .small-box pair AND no LARGE-ONLY marker

## Regression Risk Analysis

### A5 (delete layout.groups) risks:
1. Historical bug 3fe4a8b Bug #1: mergeByIdUnion keyField=parentId — eliminated, no groups array to merge
2. Historical bug 3fe4a8b Bug #3: unstar tombstone — simplified, box.isParent=false is the tombstone
3. Historical bug 2728d98: groupIdx invalidation after cross-tab merge — eliminated, box mergeById already syncs isParent
4. Historical bug 3fe4a8b Bug #6: renderInnerSurface disposeAllConns -> renderConnections — unaffected (SVG layer invariant stays)
5. Box objects without isParent field (legacy data) — migration: default to false, or check layout.groups for legacy

### A6 (storage.local) risks:
1. chrome.storage.sync quota: MAX_WRITE_OPERATIONS_PER_MINUTE = 120 (not 1200, confirmed Chrome docs)
   - AGENTS.md SEC-08 says 1200 — this is WRONG, needs correction in Phase 6
2. storage.local = 10MB (Chrome 113+) / 5MB (older) — unlimitedStorage permission required
3. onChanged cross-tab: confirmed works for storage.local in both Chrome and Firefox
4. Legacy data in storage.sync: one-time migration on loadLayout, copy boxingLayout to local, set migration=false
5. background.js debug flag stays on sync (small data, cross-device useful)
6. WebDAV/Gist backup: reads from in-memory layout object, unaffected by storage backend
7. localStorage fallback (BX-AUD-04): keep as safety net, rarely triggered with local 10MB

### A4 (perf) risks:
1. Viewport culling: must handle box wrapping (large box encloses small boxes, viewport check on large only)
2. SVG pooling: pool size bounded to MAX_CONNECTIONS (5000 per docs/design-box-connections.md)
3. LOD: zoom threshold must match existing 30% min zoom (zoom range 0.3-3.0 per BX-DEV-001)
4. ResizeObserver: must not double-trigger conn refresh (ResizeObserver + drag both fire)
